summary: One church, Notre Dame, North Caldwell. Weekend Masses, weekday Masses in the on-site Parish Center Chapel and Saturday 4:00-4:30 confession agree in both bulletins (Nov 8, Nov 15) and on the website; the newest bulletin cancels three Saturday confessions and adds Monday, December 21 4-7 PM. Open: how to record the weekday 7 AM Mass, which stops in an undated summer.
